title: One polynomial per eigenvalue: the kernels of the cut-open torus at powers of two
claim: At n = 2^m, h = n/2, q = 2n, for b in GF(q)* and X_b the operator F -> (k + 1) F(k + 1) + Omega_b(k) F(k) mod k^h on F[k]_(<h) whose kernel is ker(I + C_s(b^2)) (LINEAR-ROOTS-20261109-001A, Theorem 2): (1) the shift F -> (k + 1) F(k + 1) mod k^h and every multiplication mod k^h are self-adjoint for <F, G> = sum over j < h of [k^j](F G), so X_b is self-adjoint and its kernel is the radical of <X_b F, G>; (2) any two solutions satisfy F_1(k) F_2(k + 1) = F_1(k + 1) F_2(k); (3) if the kernel is nonzero and G_b is a least-degree solution, the solutions are exactly G_b r(Y), Y = k^2 + k, r a polynomial, of degree below h, so dim ker X_b = ceil((h - deg G_b)/2); (4) with U the element of F[k]/(k^h (k + 1)^h) equal to Omega_b/(k + 1) mod k^h and k/Omega_b(k + 1) mod (k + 1)^h, U = U_0(Y) + k U_1(Y) and psi_b = (1 + U_0)/(1 + Y U_1) mod Y^h, F = A(Y) + k C(Y) is a solution exactly when deg A, deg C < h/2 and C = psi_b A mod Y^h, so dim ker X_b = h/2 - rank T_b for the Toeplitz matrix T_b = (psi_b)_(h/2 + j - i). Computed exactly: deg G_b = h - k_b with k_b = (|K(b) - 1| - 1)/2 and the kernel's valuations 0, ..., dim - 1, every b at sides 8 to 512 (stress run 256 and 512); rank T_b equals the linear complexity of psi_1, ..., psi_(h-1), both h/2 - |K(b)|/4, every b at sides 8 to 64. The target registered with this ticket, deg G_b <= h - k_b and the Jordan chains, and with them the collapse, is not proved: the eigenvector lower bound is exactly that degree bound, and no argument found ties it to the Kloosterman sum.
failure_conditions: A side 2^m and b in GF(2n)* at which X_b is not self-adjoint for <F, G>.
Two solutions F_1, F_2 with F_1(k) F_2(k + 1) != F_1(k + 1) F_2(k).
A side and b at which the solutions are not G r(Y) for one G, or deg G_b != h - k_b (computed false at 8 to 128; side 256 is the stress run).
foundation_claim_scope: The square torus of rule-60 rings with equally spaced law-(12, 12) contacts, cut open by a ring of cuts each way (A30, A32, A37, A38); its walk over GF(2), at sides 2^m. The spectrum is a contact-level reading, so it does not depend on how the rings are declared (A45).
